digest.component_or_area: code review trigger system / project overlays
propositions: The committed high-precision trigger tier fires on 13.3% of rebar diffs; the project-level noisy tier adds 22.0% more coverage, for 35.3% combined fire-rate.
Three traced corpus bugs trigger only through noisy-tier vocabulary tokens (.lock, retry, Popen), making the project overlay load-bearing for this dogfood target.
The project overlay mechanism merges trigger_tokens and applies_to globs from .rebar/criteria_routing.json per-key over the committed routing without silent re-tuning of posture/threshold.
A diff containing index.lock (a project token) must fire the concurrency overlay when content_triggered_overlays reads this repo's effective routing, but not fire under committed-only routing.
Documentation of the two-layer design, fire-rate measurement methodology, and project vocabulary extension pattern must be added to docs/llm-framework.md as a worked example.
